title: On profinite rigidity, Grothendieck pairs, and the second homology of some $3$-orbifold groups
summary: The second homology group is of central importance in the study of profinite rigidity of $3$-manifold groups. Although general and deep results imply that the integral homology of cocompact hyperbolic $3$-orbifold groups is computable in principle, the resulting algorithm is not practical. We develop an effective method for computing $H_2$ in the case of orbifold groups arising as finite extensions of the fundamental group of hyperbolic rational homology $3$-spheres.
